name: objective-chain-advance
intent: Four objective checkpoints latch in sequence (200ms complete + 220ms pulse) until MISSION CLEAR.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Resolved Objective Chain Advance state immediately

acceptance: Exactly 4 checkpoints latch with completeMs 200 between nodes
Inter-node pulse runs pulseMs 220 before next checkpoint activates
Status becomes MISSION CLEAR only after last checkpoint + settleMs 100
Replay resets all nodes to pending/current before rerunning
Reduced motion shows all checkpoints complete as MISSION CLEAR
